text: Bingo 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件善后助手，在应用界面加入悬浮按钮和管理面板，集中呈现新增插件待重启、插件状态、试用决定与变更记录。它支持插件名搜索、状态筛选、诊断摘要、重启提醒和多种恢复工具，包括配置回滚、最小启动、残留隔离及启动耗时趋势。适合管理桌面 Harness 插件并排查更新后的运行问题；无需额外 API Key，完整重启需要官方 Electron 桌面端。

Bingo adds a button and panel to DeepSeek Harness for plugin status, trials, and change history. It offers search, restart reminders, diagnostic summaries, rollback, minimal startup, quarantine, and startup timing. No API key is needed; full restarts require the official Electron desktop app.

Can I review plugin changes and roll back to an earlier package list?
Bingo 的功能「插件状态与搜索」：Bingo 的插件管家可按名称搜索，并筛选加载异常、试用、最近变更或已禁用项目；列表显示宿主报告的状态和版本。
Bingo 的功能「新插件重启提醒」：检测到 profile 新增插件时，Bingo 显示待处理提醒；用户可触发重启或暂缓当前这组提醒。
Bingo 的功能「插件试用决定」：用户可标记插件试用，并选择保留、下次启动再问或确认移除；移除操作交给宿主插件管理器。
Bingo 的功能「插件记录与恢复工具」：Bingo 保存插件变更记录和检查点，并提供清单回滚、最小启动、隔离残留目录及启动趋势查看入口。
Bingo 的完整应用重启依赖官方 Electron 桌面端；Web 模式只提供页面刷新。重启会中断当前任务，操作前应保存工作。

text: dsh-bingo-ren README · 少找一页，少选一次：在插件列表里直接搜索、查看状态并标记试用。下一次启动时，试用提醒让你决定：**保留、下次再问，还是确认移除**。试用不会隔离权限或自动卸载。 列表按异常优先显示，覆盖当前清单中的最多 1000 个插件；“最近变更”单独筛选，不再让异常插件受旧的 30 项验收目标范围限制。 **运行中**只表示宿主条目已启动，业务功能与实际加载代码版本仍需验证。宿主缺少可靠信息时显示**无法确认**。

dsh-bingo-ren README · 求助时，先生成一份能用的摘要：概览中的 **生成排查摘要 → 复制摘要**，整理包名、声明版本、宿主报告状态和近期变更。生成后可先核对，再复制给维护者。

摘要不读取聊天或配置，不带 profile 路径、日志路径或原始错误文本；本地依赖与自定义下载来源的地址会省略。插件清单本身也可能透露使用习惯，分享前由你核对。剪贴板不可用时可选中文本手动复制。Bingo 不会自动发送摘要。

dsh-bingo-ren README · 出问题时，按顺序找线索：先看**概览的异常**，再看**最近变更**；需要恢复时进入 **恢复与工具**。
回滚：退回之前的插件清单 每次观察到清单变化，保留变化前的检查点（最近 8 个）。确认后通过宿主原生插件管理器增删包、恢复已记录的版本声明与启用状态；插件数据目录保留。完成后需要重启。 0.6.0 修正了启用状态在活动清单及检查点中丢失的问题，新记录会保留这项信息。旧记录中缺失的启用状态无法追溯：恢复已安装包时保留当前启用选择，不凭空假设它过去启用了。

text:
dsh-bingo-ren README · 出问题时，按顺序找线索：先完整备份 profile 的 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml` / `.yaml`；独立 helper 等旧 shell、宿主与端口退出后，才切换配置。最小启动只保留 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 和 Bingo，暂时清空 profile 自定义补丁，不卸载依赖，不删除插件数据。

之后可按备份恢复，包含原格式与注释。遇到备份方案之外的新配置改动时拒绝覆盖。此功能针对标准桌面 profile，全局／命令行覆盖层与宿主本身故障不在处理范围。

Windows 独立急救入口在正常加载时提前保存：打开 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\bingo\救援`，完全退出 Harness，再运行 `Bingo-…-急救.cmd`。自定义 `DSH_HOME` / `DSH_BINGO_HOME` 时，以面板显示的路径为准。独立副本不依赖安装包之后是否完好。

若副本尚未生成，可从 Release 解压安装包，在完全退出应用后运行：

dsh-bingo-ren README · 出问题时，按顺序找线索：```powershell
node lib/rescue-cli.mjs enter --profile "你的 profile 完整目录" --closed --apply
node lib/rescue-cli.mjs restore --profile "你的 profile 完整目录" --closed --apply

`status` 为只读；`enter --without-bingo` 可只保留两个官方基础包。备份可能包含原配置凭据，应保存在本机，不要上传原始备份。

旧版 profile 范围的停用记录仍可确认恢复；更早的无 profile 标识记录不自动归属，核对插件名后在原 profile 手动恢复，见 [开发说明](https://github.com/kongkongya367-glitch/dsh-bingo-ren/blob/main/SPEC.md)。

text:
dsh-bingo-ren README · 出问题时，按顺序找线索： 在「恢复与工具」选择「残留隔离与恢复」。扫描至少静置 10 分钟的 `.ignored` 副本、PID 已退出的临时包目录，以及记录中已移除、名称精确匹配且未在其他可读标准 profile 中安装的数据目录。大小可能只是估算。 候选仍需核对用途。勾选后移动到同卷隔离区，可恢复；原位置已有新内容时停止覆盖。隔离不释放磁盘空间，再次确认永久删除后才释放。不会整目录删除 `.ignored`，不会按“清单里没有”删除传递依赖，不跟随符号链接或 junction 祖先，保护活动引用和 Bingo 自身代码。
启动趋势：同一观测点下对照变化
section: 出问题时，按顺序找线索

text:
dsh-bingo-ren README · 出问题时，按顺序找线索：在工具选择「启动趋势」。保存最近 60 次观测，口径是**宿主进程启动到 Bingo 界面首次连接就绪**，不包含完整 Electron 启动。显示就绪时的包数、运行／失败条目与异常包数，并对照插件变化。

最小启动、热接入和观察点超过 2 分钟的样本单列，不计入普通启动均值。未知状态保持未知，没有界面确认不等于启动失败。耗时和插件变化只供关联对照，不证明哪个插件导致变慢，也不补造历史。

</details>

dsh-bingo-ren README · Four places, clear next actions：| Destination | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Overview | New plugins awaiting restart, trials awaiting a decision and host-reported failures, with direct actions |
| Plugins | Search by name; filter failures, trials, recent changes or disabled entries; inspect status and decide trial outcomes in the same row |
| Changes | Additions, declared version changes, enable/disable changes, removals and trial decisions |
| Recovery & tools | Rollback, minimal boot and independent rescue; select quarantine or startup trends when needed |

dsh-bingo-ren README · Four places, clear next actions： The plugin list covers up to 1000 declared packages, with failures first. Recent changes are a filter rather than the only runtime-check targets. Trials ask on the next boot: keep, defer or explicitly remove. They do not isolate permissions or auto-uninstall.

dsh-bingo-ren README · Four places, clear next actions：“Active” means a host entry has started. Actual business behaviour and loaded code version still require verification; unavailable host information stays unknown.

dsh-bingo-ren README · Useful information when asking for help：Generate a diagnostic summary from Overview, review it, then copy. It includes package names, declared versions, reported states and recent changes. Local/custom source addresses are omitted. It does not read chats or configuration, nor include profile paths, log paths or raw errors. The list of installed plugins can still reveal usage habits; review before sharing. A selectable-text fallback works when clipboard access is unavailable. Nothing is sent automatically.

text:
dsh-bingo-ren README · Install：In Harness, **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**:

```text
dsh-bingo-ren
```

Or use `https://github.com/kongkongya367-glitch/dsh-bingo-ren`.

**Quit and reopen Harness once after installation or an update.** A release-age policy may postpone automatic updates; pin `dsh-bingo-ren@0.6.0` if the host permits it. Check the version actually installed.

dsh-bingo-ren README · Install：Requires Node.js 20+ and Harness 0.2.0-rc.1+. Whole-app restart needs the official Electron desktop app and interrupts running tasks: save your work first. Web mode offers page refresh.

The draggable button snaps to edges, remembers position and supports light/dark themes. `Ctrl+Alt+B` opens the panel (`Cmd+Alt+B` on macOS). New-plugin reminders remember a deferred group and notify again for a newer group.
dsh-bingo-ren README · Recovery boundaries：

dsh-bingo-ren README · Recovery boundaries：- **Rollback:** last eight pre-change inventory checkpoints, delegated to the native manager. Plugin data remains. Version 0.6.0 fixes dropped enablement in newly recorded checkpoints and keeps disabled packages disabled through reinstall. Older unknown enablement is not invented: currently installed packages keep their current choice.
- **Minimal boot:** back up package.json and profile YAML byte-for-byte, wait for the old processes and port to exit, then select only dsh-base, dsh-web-app and Bingo while temporarily neutralizing profile patches. Installed dependencies and data remain. Restore refuses unrelated configuration edits. Only the standard desktop profile layout is supported; global/CLI overlays and host faults are outside its scope.
- **Independent rescue:** a Windows launcher is saved after a healthy load under the local Bingo state's `救援` directory. Close Harness completely before using it. It survives later package damage. Alternatively extract a release and run `node lib/rescue-cli.mjs enter --profile <absolute-profile> --closed --apply`; use `restore` to recover. `--without-bingo` excludes Bingo too; `status` is read-only.

dsh-bingo-ren README · Recovery boundaries：- **Startup trends:** up to sixty local observations from host-process start to first Bingo UI connection. This is not total Electron startup. Minimal, hot-attached and late observations are separate from ordinary averages. Unknowns remain unknown. Changes alongside timing do not establish causality; no history is fabricated.

dsh-bingo-ren README · Recovery boundaries：Advanced recovery UI loads on demand. The new client requests leftover scanning only when quarantine is selected. Missing advanced UI does not prevent ordinary plugin viewing or restart controls.

dsh-bingo-ren README · Recovery boundaries：Records are per profile under local Bingo state: last 200 history entries, 100 displayed; recording starts with a quiet baseline. Unchanged version ranges with changed lockfile resolutions are not yet detected. No telemetry, no runtime dependencies, MIT licensed. Confirmed native package operations may contact the configured registry. Filesystem writes share the host's native PID-lock protocol.

dsh-bingo-ren README · Recovery boundaries：Screenshots are real browser captures using mock data.
